message:
I fixed it by changing `uploads.maxMb` in `config/default.json` from 5 to 10, which matches the 10 MB limit in `docs/product.md`. `npm test` now passes all 4 tests, including the 8 MB PDF case.

The API body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is computed from the same setting (limit plus 1 MB for multipart overhead). It now allows 11 MB, so it needs no separate change.
